text:
kevin: quick flag - finance noticed duplicated NetSuite invoices created during a webhook burst last night. Not charging duplicates but portal shows 2 entries for some customers.

samir: when did you first see it?

kevin: around 2024-11-02 03:01 UTC. Pattern: same stripe invoice id ends up as two NetSuite records (different ns_id).

mira: any logs?

kevin: pasted a short snippet from webhook-bridge: 
```
2024-11-02T03:01:12Z INFO webhook received evt=invoice.finalized id=evt_ABC123 headers={idempotency-key=hdr-xyz, x-request-id=req-1}
2024-11-02T03:01:12Z WARN proxy normalized headers, dropped non-whitelisted: [idempotency-key]
2024-11-02T03:01:13Z INFO ns-connector createInvoice payload={"total":45000,"externalId": null}
2024-11-02T03:01:13Z INFO ns-connector created ns_id=NS-1001
2024-11-02T03:01:20Z INFO webhook retry evt=evt_ABC123 attempt=2
2024-11-02T03:01:20Z INFO ns-connector createInvoice payload={"total":45000,"externalId":"inv_7Gf"}
2024-11-02T03:01:20Z INFO ns-connector created ns_id=NS-1002
```

ana: so bridge lost the idempotency header during the first call and the connector couldn't populate externalId. Why only during the spike?

samir: we shipped a chunked-proxy a few weeks back that starts channeling large webhooks through a different path which normalizes headers. Looks like it didn't whitelist idempotency-key.

mira: billing-bot shows an alert at the same time: 
```
billing-bot: chunked-proxy trimmed 3 headers on webhook-bridge 2024-11-02T03:01:12Z - removed: idempotency-key, x-stripe-signature, x-request-id
```

kevin: impact summary: 9 duplicated NetSuite invoices across ~10 minutes, 7 misattributions in last-run reconciliation. No net revenue variance. Customers might see duplicate invoice numbers in the portal.

an a: proposed mitigation: 1) whitelist idempotency-key and x-stripe-signature in proxy config (hotfix) 2) add fallback in ns-connector to extract stripe.invoice.id from request body when externalId header missing 3) run a de-dup/merge job in NetSuite and produce audit CSV for finance/outreach.

samir: I'll land the proxy whitelist and deploy. Also add unit test for header preservation.

kevin: I'll add the fallback on connector and write a reconcile query to identify duplicates. Mira, can you run the duplicate finder?

mira: query ready: 
```
SELECT stripe_invoice_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, ARRAY_AGG(netsuite_id) as ns_ids
FROM analytics.netsuite_invoices
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY stripe_invoice_id
HAVING cnt > 1;
```
I'll run it and produce the CSV.

billing-bot: deploy webhook-bridge hotfix succeeded 2024-11-02T04:15:05Z - proxy whitelist updated.

samir: ns-connector patch merged: if payload.externalId is null and body.invoice.id exists then set externalId = body.invoice.id before create. Unit tests added.

kevin: ran sandbox merge: 9 duplicate pairs merged, audit CSV attached to FIN ticket FIN-BILL-341. No revenue delta.

mira: outreach draft: "We detected duplicate billing entries in your billing portal caused by a short sync issue. Charges are unchanged; we've merged duplicate entries and updated your invoice view. Contact us if you have questions."

ana: assigning FIN-BILL-341 P2. Action owners: Samir (proxy + connector tests), Kevin (merge script + audit), Mira (outreach). Please follow up with a short postmortem next week. :thumbsup:
